issue.body:
I would expect the AuthBackend to be used in the account route but it never gets used. However the CORS headers are added for all routes as expected.
```python
app = Starlette()
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_headers=['*'], allow_methods=['*'], allow_origins=['*'])
account = Starlette()
account.add_middleware(AuthenticationMiddleware, backend=AuthBackend())
app.mount('/account', account)
```
I don't know if this is a bug or if there's another way to do this
issue.title: Authenticate only a specific route
